description: Defines the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity class for ORM, representing employee termination data with properties like termination date, note, reason, and associated employee.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecord
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's termination record, including termination date, note, reason, and employee association.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the termination record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the termination record.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the termination.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the termination record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with the termination record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the termination record.
